subject.title: fix: skip setup-only channel plugins in outbound resolution and drain pending deliveries on qqbot reconnect

question: Should QQBot READY and RESUMED immediately bypass delivery-queue backoff for the current broad transport-error predicate, or only for failures proven to occur before any platform send?
rationale: The queue's claim, evidence-preservation, retry-limit, and pacing safeguards make both approaches mechanically viable, but retry timing, duplicate exposure, and QQ platform rate-limit pressure require channel and outbound owner intent.

options.title: Narrow proven-unsent bypass
options.body: Immediately retry only errors that establish the platform was not called, including the reported outbound-not-configured failure.

options.title: Accept the broad predicate
options.body: Keep immediate replay for disconnected, gateway, and outbound-not-configured matches and explicitly own the retry-pressure tradeoff.

options.title: Honor normal backoff
options.body: Trigger a reconnect drain but leave every matching entry subject to its existing retry deadline.

recommendation.title: Narrow proven-unsent bypass
recommendation.body: Immediately retry only errors that establish the platform was not called, including the reported outbound-not-configured failure.

likelyOwner.reason: They explicitly offered QQBot review for this PR and are the best available owner to coordinate the channel decision with shared outbound contributors.
